blocks.contents: future wire rejections, through FND-02 registration
config, content, map and world load, boot, shutdown
Postgres, fences, SQLSTATE OTN*/OTI*/OTC*, stored-state integrity
fail-closed invariant breaks that are not sent on the wire
registration, runtime status (NotDelivered classes), grant verification
oteryn-game-ops failures; exit codes stay 2-7 as the coarse class
connect, asset, render and local storage failures
governance, repository policy, content validators, qualification
assigned only by a later amendment

codes.name: CONFIG_INVALID
codes.hint: Boot exit 10: a startup config key is missing or invalid; the detail names the key.

codes.name: BOOT_DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE
codes.hint: Boot exit 11: the Postgres connection failed; check the database URL, network and credentials.

codes.name: BOOT_REGISTRATION_REJECTED
codes.hint: Boot exit 12: GameNode registration was rejected (see OTN01); check the launch authorization.

codes.name: BOOT_SOURCE_CUSTODY_FAILED
codes.hint: Boot exit 13: S2 source custody failed; the detail names the stage.

codes.name: BOOT_CHARACTER_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE
codes.hint: Boot exit 14: Character authority was unavailable at boot.

codes.name: BOOT_ASSIGNMENT_WAIT_TIMEOUT
codes.hint: Boot exit 15: no operator assignment arrived within the wait; issue the assignment and restart.

codes.name: BOOT_BIND_FAILED
codes.hint: Boot exit 16: a listener could not bind; check the port is free and the address is configured.

codes.name: BOOT_READINESS_FAILED
codes.hint: Boot exit 17: readiness publication failed at the named stage.

codes.name: BOOT_CLOCK_SKEW
codes.hint: Boot exit 17: the clock skew exceeds the uncertainty bound; check host time sync.

codes.name: BOOT_SERVE_CONFIG_REJECTED
codes.hint: Boot exit 18: the gameplay listener configuration was rejected.

codes.name: BOOT_CONTENT_ACTIVATION_REFUSED
codes.hint: Boot exit 19: native entry Content activation was refused at the named stage.

codes.name: BOOT_WORLD_BUNDLE_REFUSED
codes.hint: Boot exit 20: the configured world bundle failed a boot check; the detail names the refusal.

codes.name: BOOT_WORLD_BUNDLE_UNSERVED
codes.hint: Boot exit 21: the world bundle is valid but serving it needs client capability 18; no listener opened.

codes.name: LOG_SPEC_INVALID
codes.hint: OTERYN_LOG is not `level` or `module=level` entries; the process refused to start with exit 2.

codes.name: SCHEDULER_JOB_FAILED
codes.hint: A bounded scheduler or World pass failed and will be retried.

codes.name: REGISTRATION_REJECTED
codes.hint: SQLSTATE OTN01: GameNode registration or launch authorization revocation rejected.

codes.name: NODE_INCARNATION_NOT_CURRENT
codes.hint: SQLSTATE OTN02: the GameNode process incarnation is not current; a newer process owns the node.

codes.name: DESCRIPTOR_ISSUANCE_CONFLICT
codes.hint: SQLSTATE OTN03: descriptor issuance or fresh-store authorization conflicts with the recorded revision.

codes.name: INBOX_ITEM_HAS_CONTENTS
codes.hint: SQLSTATE OTI01: the item delivered to an Inbox has contents.

codes.name: INBOX_WORLD_MISMATCH
codes.hint: SQLSTATE OTI02: the item or the Character is not of the given World.

codes.name: INBOX_ITEM_IN_ANOTHER_LOCATION
codes.hint: SQLSTATE OTI03: the item is already in an Inbox or still in another location at commit.

codes.name: INBOX_UNKNOWN_CAUSE_KIND
codes.hint: SQLSTATE OTI04: the cause kind has no registry row.

codes.name: INBOX_ALREADY_DELIVERED
codes.hint: SQLSTATE OTI05: this (item, cause) was already delivered.

codes.name: CONTENT_ACTIVATION_SEQUENCE_CONFLICT
codes.hint: SQLSTATE OTC01: Content activation conflicts with the recorded sequence, or a referenced shaping revision cannot be dropped.

codes.name: MIGRATION_FAILED
codes.hint: oteryn-game-migrate failed with no registered SQLSTATE; the error text is in detail; exit 1.

codes.name: PROFICIENCY_IMPORT_FAILED
codes.hint: oteryn-game-import-proficiencies failed with no registered SQLSTATE; the error text is in detail; exit 1.

codes.name: DURABILITY_TRANSACTION_FAILED
codes.hint: A bounded semantic transaction could not begin or install its transaction timeouts; retry through the owning operation.

codes.name: PANIC
codes.hint: A thread panicked; the line has thread, location and a static payload; the process follows the panic profile.

codes.name: PLATFORM_REPORT_INVALID
codes.hint: NotDelivered invalid_report: the local runtime status is outside the contract grammar; nothing was sent.

codes.name: PLATFORM_REQUEST_MALFORMED
codes.hint: NotDelivered malformed: Platform answered 400 to the runtime status report.

codes.name: PLATFORM_UNAUTHENTICATED
codes.hint: NotDelivered unauthenticated: Platform answered 401; check the credential, purpose and scope.

codes.name: PLATFORM_CONFLICT
codes.hint: NotDelivered conflict: Platform answered 409; epoch, generation or ordering conflicts with the assignment.

codes.name: PLATFORM_RATE_LIMITED
codes.hint: NotDelivered rate_limited: Platform answered 429; retry within the bounded policy.

codes.name: PLATFORM_RESPONSE_INVALID
codes.hint: NotDelivered invalid_response: the Platform response is outside the contract.

codes.name: PLATFORM_UNAVAILABLE
codes.hint: NotDelivered unavailable: Platform answered 503 or another status, or the transport failed.

codes.name: CHAR_CMD_BAZAAR_STALE_REVISION
codes.hint: Bazaar expected custody or eligibility revision is stale.

codes.name: CHAR_CMD_BAZAAR_OBLIGATION
codes.hint: Resolve the authoritative guild, market, housing or cooldown obligation before a new attempt.

codes.name: CHAR_CMD_BAZAAR_ITEM_NOT_TRANSFERABLE
codes.hint: The instance, attributes or quantity cannot be conserved by this Bazaar profile.

codes.name: CHAR_CMD_BAZAAR_DESTINATION_UNAVAILABLE
codes.hint: The exact durable destination cannot receive; escrow remains unchanged.

codes.name: CHAR_CMD_BAZAAR_HOLD_CONFLICT
codes.hint: Gold availability, seller headroom or hold disposition forbids this operation.

codes.name: CHAR_CMD_BAZAAR_PAYOUT_INVALID
codes.hint: The delivery binding or exact payout arithmetic is invalid; no gold effect.

codes.name: CHAR_CMD_ACCOUNT_CLOSE_STALE_GENERATION
codes.hint: Reconcile the account lifecycle and Game recovery generation before issuing a new close attempt.

codes.name: CHAR_CMD_ACCOUNT_CLOSE_OBLIGATION
codes.hint: An owning domain cannot safely detach or finalize this account.

codes.name: CHAR_CMD_ACCOUNT_CLOSE_RESOLUTION_CONFLICT
codes.hint: A different terminal cancellation or finalization already won for this termination.

codes.name: OPS_USAGE
codes.hint: ops exit 2: wrong command line; read the usage text.

codes.name: OPS_INPUT_INVALID
codes.hint: ops exit 3: an input file or value is invalid; the detail names it.

codes.name: OPS_IDENTITY_MISMATCH
codes.hint: ops exit 4: the operator or request identity does not match; do not retry unchanged.

codes.name: OPS_UNAVAILABLE
codes.hint: ops exit 5: the database or a dependency is unavailable; retry later.

codes.name: OPS_REJECTED
codes.hint: ops exit 6: the store rejected the request; the detail names the reason.

codes.name: OPS_OUTCOME_AMBIGUOUS
codes.hint: ops exit 7: the outcome is unknown; reconcile the retained request before retrying.

codes.name: OPS_LOG_SPEC_INVALID
codes.hint: OTERYN_LOG is not `level` or `module=level` entries; oteryn-game-ops refused to start with exit 2.

codes.name: GOVERNANCE_CHECK_FAILED
codes.hint: Governance validator exit 1: a governance check failed; the message names the file or rule.

codes.name: REPOSITORY_POLICY_CHECK_FAILED
codes.hint: Repository policy validator exit 1: a policy check failed; the message names the check.
